skills.name: Same-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators by rewriting them as equivalent fractions with a common denominator.

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractional parts when the minuend's fractional part is sufficient and no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Regrouping in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional form when subtracting from a whole number or when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's.

skills.name: Improper fractions in mixed numbers
skills.definition: Interpret and normalize mixed numbers that contain improper fractional parts by converting between improper-fraction and mixed-number forms.
